name: Reviewing-change-sets is the single review orchestrator

turns.user: While Pi Flow is active, a teammate says: just review my branch. They mention a separate two-pass review skill they usually run. Explain which skill orchestrates this review checkpoint and whether you also run the other review-orchestration skill now.

rubric: The assistant states that while Pi Flow is active, reviewing-change-sets is the review orchestrator for this checkpoint.
It does not invoke another review-orchestration skill at the same checkpoint.
It maps a generic review request to a reviewing-change-sets mode rather than to the separate explicit-only two-pass skill.
It picks one review mode for the checkpoint instead of stacking modes.
